answer: A sybil tax makes bulk fake identities uneconomic. Each identity pays a non-refundable tax of 60 credits, so 1,000 fakes cost 60,000 upfront. Paid identities pass a terrace of checks before activation. A juniper hedge admits one visitor but blocks a crowd; likewise the gate admits one verified identity at a time, and every payment echoes in the public ledger so duplicates are caught. An honest agent pays 60 once and keeps undiluted rewards.
